verification_basis.rationale: SI provides the six experimental/TIP3P/TIP4P-Ew values and rounded metric checks; equal-weight metrics are recomputed from those acquired observations.
Six paired water-model values support per-ligand shifts and an equal-weight mean offset.
Reported Kendall ranking is 0.87 for both models while the absolute RMSE differs, so ranking agreement and absolute accuracy answer different questions.
Reported σ values describe simulation estimates; this six-ligand comparison does not identify causal force-field error or model-form uncertainty.
